scenes.narration_en: Just before midnight, around 11:30 p.m., rain hammered the loading yard at Hai Yen Port on Thanh Lam Street. Among rows of silent containers, near container 14, lay Trinh Quang Vu, the forty-eight-year-old director of Sao Bien Shipping Company. He was already dead.

A single fatal wound to the back of his neck, made by something sharp. The person who found him was Dang Thu Ha, his thirty-six-year-old chief accountant. She had ridden her motorbike, plate 29C2-456.78, back to the office to pick up the financial ledgers, and walked straight into the scene.

Shaking, she called the police duty desk from 0987 654 321. Her voice cracked as she described a figure in a dark jacket sprinting through the port gate and vanishing into the pouring rain. Who was that figure?
